verses.1: So, my beloved and cherished brothers and sisters, you are my joy and my crown. Stand firm in your faith, dear ones.
verses.2: I also ask Eudoxia to take care of this matter, and I also ask Synthechis to do the same.
verses.3: I also ask for your forgiveness, my true husband. I accept their prayers, because in the gospel, they have accompanied me along with Clement and all my other companions. Their names are recorded in the Book of Life.
verses.4: Happy are those who always remain in their Lord’s service. Once again, I say: Happy are they.
verses.5: That your excellence should be known by all people. The Lord is near.
verses.6: Do not worry at all. Instead, in every prayer and request, with gratitude, let me know your requests to the God.
verses.7: And the peace of God will surely protect all your thoughts and intentions in Christ Jesus.
verses.8: Therefore, brothers, whatever is true, whatever is pure, whatever is just, whatever is holy, whatever is kind, whatever is honorable, and whatever deserves praise or appreciation, consider those things as worthy of consideration.
verses.9: And you shall also learn, receive, hear, and see these things through me. And the God of peace will be with you.
verses.10: I was very surprised to hear that you have already begun to take care of things on my behalf. May you be able to do so in time.
verses.11: Not that it’s too much to say, for I have learned in my heart who I truly am.
verses.12: I know that it’s humiliating, I know that it’s excessive. In every situation, I feel sad and depressed. I’m exhausted and overwhelmed, and I feel like I’m being overworked and exploited.
verses.13: I always remain strong within my power.
verses.14: In addition, you have done well to join me in my sorrow.
verses.15: And you also know, Philippians, that at the beginning of the gospel, when we came from Macedonia, no church gave me any message for preaching and encouragement, except for you alone.
verses.16: Because even in Thessaloniki, you sent me six items that were useful to me.
verses.17: I don’t just demand the fruit itself; I also demand that the one who has an advantage in this discussion be punished for it.
verses.18: I, however, hold back everything and overdo it. I will, therefore, fill up the containers given to me by Epaphroditus with what you have given me. It’s a pleasing offering to the God.
verses.19: But my God will pay for all your debts through His riches, in the glory of Christ Jesus.
verses.20: May the glory of our God and Father endure for ever. Amen.
verses.21: May you always be holy in Christ Jesus. Your brothers who are with me will also be holy.
verses.22: All the saints are competing with you, especially those who belong to the household of the Emperor.
verses.23: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, along with the Holy Spirit.
